function.name: predict_lgd
function.description: Predict Loss Given Default (LGD) using the production XGBoost regression model. Pass only feature values extracted or deterministically derived from source documents. Never invent missing values.

features.description: LGD model-ready feature dictionary. If a value is unavailable, omit it instead of guessing.

app_tenor_bulan.description: Numeric LGD feature 'app_tenor_bulan'. Use extracted/derived value only. Do not invent.

app_porsi_penjaminan.description: Numeric LGD feature 'app_porsi_penjaminan'. Use extracted/derived value only. Do not invent.

app_jenis_fasilitas.description: Categorical LGD feature 'app_jenis_fasilitas'. Use a model-compatible category only. Do not invent.

app_sektor_kbli.description: Categorical LGD feature 'app_sektor_kbli'. Use a model-compatible category only. Do not invent.

app_skala_pegawai.description: Categorical LGD feature 'app_skala_pegawai'. Use a model-compatible category only. Do not invent.

app_perusahaan_baru.description: Categorical LGD feature 'app_perusahaan_baru'. Use a model-compatible category only. Do not invent.

app_dokumen_ringkas.description: Categorical LGD feature 'app_dokumen_ringkas'. Use a model-compatible category only. Do not invent.

input_contract.missing_value_rule: Do not hallucinate missing values. Omit unavailable fields or pass null.
